# Rose by Marry — full reference for AI assistants

> Handmade satin roses in Tangier. Roses en satin faites main à Tanger. ورود ساتان مصنوعة يدوياً في طنجة.
> URL: https://rosebymarry.com/ · Updated: 2026-09-19 · Languages: AR (default), FR, EN

## What this business is
Rose by Marry is a family atelier in Tangier, Morocco, handcrafting satin roses that never wilt. Customers order ready bouquets or build custom ones (5–30 roses) on the website, choose a color, optional add-ons, then complete the order over WhatsApp with cash on delivery.

## Rose colors (editable live by the shop)
- Blue / Bleu / أزرق — #3A5FA8
- Red / Rouge / أحمر — #C8102E
- Dark Red / Rouge foncé / أحمر داكن — #6E1423
- Tangier Blue / Bleu Tanger / أزرق طنجة — #1E6FA8
- Tangier Pink / Rose Tanger / وردي طنجة — #E5699B

## Custom bouquet builder
Tiers: 1 roses = 10 MAD · 5 roses = 45 MAD · 10 roses = 90 MAD · 15 roses = 135 MAD · 20 roses = 180 MAD · 30 roses = 270 MAD
Custom quantity: 9 MAD per rose. Add-ons: Butterflies (Fraschat)/Papillons (Fraschat)/فراشات (فراشات) +5 MAD · Crown (Taj)/Couronne (Taj)/تاج +20 MAD · Lace/Dentelle/دانتيل +25 MAD · Ribbon / Gift Card/Ruban / Carte-message/شريط / بطاقة إهداء +0 MAD (optional gift text)

## Order & delivery policy
- Delivery area: **Tangier city only** (no shipping to other cities).
- Delivery fee: 20 MAD · free over 500 MAD.
- Payment: cash on delivery (COD) — no prepayment.
- Ordering: checkout opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled order message; customers keep an order ID for tracking at https://rosebymarry.com/track.
- Store WhatsApp: +212772966980

## FAQ
Q: Do roses wilt? A: No — they are handmade from satin and last for years.
Q: Do you ship outside Tangier? A: No, delivery is inside Tangier only.
Q: Can I choose the color? A: Yes — Blue, Red, Dark Red, Tangier Blue, Tangier Pink — chosen per product and in the builder.
Q: How do I pay? A: Cash on delivery when the order arrives.
Q: Can I track my order? A: Yes, with your RBM order ID at https://rosebymarry.com/track.

## Site sections (beyond the catalog)
- /occasions — gift finder by occasion (wedding, birthday, anniversary, graduation, baby, thanks) with shop filters ?occ= and budget tiers ?max=99 / ?max=250.
- /offers — live offers: welcome code ROSE10 (-10% first order), free Tangier delivery from 500 DH, custom builder from 9 DH per rose.
- /care — the atelier's 6 care rules: no water ever; weekly gentle air-dusting; no direct sunlight; avoid humid rooms; fluff petals after unwrapping; store in cardboard/paper, never tight plastic. With HowTo structured data.
- /size-guide — approximate dimensions: bouquets S 5–9 roses (25cm high, 15cm Ø) / M 10–15 (35cm, 22cm) / L 16–25 (45cm, 30cm); boxes S 9 roses 15×15cm velvet / M 12–15 roses 20×20cm / L 20–25 roses 25×25cm.
- /blog — Arabic-first articles with BlogPosting + speakable structured data; each article may embed an FAQ (FAQPage schema).
- /faq — same-day Tangier delivery before 16:00, COD, 48h free replacement, custom/wedding orders via WhatsApp. FAQPage structured data.
- /ai — human-readable index of every AI/SEO file published by this site.

## FAQ (short)
Q: متى يوصل طلبي؟ A: داخل طنجة — اليوم نفسه قبل 16:00، وإلا اليوم الموالي.
Q: كيف أدفع؟ A: الدفع عند الاستلام نقداً — بلا دفع مسبق.
Q: كم تبقى ورود الساتان؟ A: سنة كاملة وأكثر مع العناية — بلا ماء ولا ضوء.
Q: هل يمكن استبدال الباقة؟ A: خلال 48 ساعة إذا كان المنتج معيباً أو مخالفاً.
